quests.hint: What word describes giving part of your work to someone else?
quests.explanation: Delegated means passed specific tasks or responsibilities to someone else. Good managers delegate rather than trying to do everything themselves.
quests.textToSpeak: The project manager delegated several tasks to junior members of the team.
quests.question: The project manager _____ several tasks to junior members of the team.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a person applying for a job or position?
quests.explanation: A candidate is someone being considered for a job or position. 'Panel interview' means several interviewers were assessing candidates together.
quests.textToSpeak: Only one candidate answered every question confidently during the panel interview.
quests.question: Only one _____ answered every question confidently during the panel interview.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes something not connected to the topic at hand?
quests.explanation: Irrelevant describes something unrelated to the topic at hand. Legal and academic writing often needs to filter out irrelevant details.
quests.textToSpeak: Most of the information in the report turned out to be irrelevant to the case.
quests.question: Most of the information in the report turned out to be _____ to the case.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes money awarded to help pay for education?
quests.explanation: A scholarship covers education costs, usually awarded based on merit or need. 'Full' means it covered the entire cost.
quests.textToSpeak: She received a full scholarship to study engineering abroad.
quests.question: She received a full _____ to study engineering abroad.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes moving an event to a new date?
quests.explanation: Rescheduled means moved to a new time, similar to 'postponed' but emphasizing that a new date was actually set.
quests.textToSpeak: The conference was rescheduled due to unexpected building repairs.
quests.question: The conference was _____ due to unexpected building repairs.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes an experienced person who guides someone less experienced?
quests.explanation: A mentor offers guidance based on their own experience. This relationship is widely recognized as valuable early in a career.
quests.textToSpeak: Having a good mentor early in your career can make a huge difference.
quests.question: Having a good _____ early in your career can make a huge difference.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes one company buying and taking over another?
quests.explanation: Acquired means bought and taken over, a word commonly used about companies. 'Much larger corporation' shows a typical business acquisition.
quests.textToSpeak: The small tech company was acquired by a much larger corporation last year.
quests.question: The small tech company was _____ by a much larger corporation last year.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes something widely admired and respected?
quests.explanation: Prestigious describes something associated with great respect and status. Awards, universities, and jobs are often described this way.
quests.textToSpeak: Winning such a prestigious award changed the course of her career.
quests.question: Winning such a _____ award changed the course of her career.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes strong public disagreement about a subject?
quests.explanation: Controversy describes a topic that causes strong, divided public opinion. 'Sparked' is the verb almost always used with this word.
quests.textToSpeak: The new policy sparked considerable controversy among local residents.
quests.question: The new policy sparked considerable _____ among local residents.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes losing a job because it's no longer needed?
quests.explanation: Redundant describes losing a job because it's no longer needed, not because of poor performance. 'The factory closed' explains the reason.
quests.textToSpeak: Two hundred workers were made redundant when the factory closed.
quests.question: Two hundred workers were made _____ when the factory closed.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes eagerly expecting something?
quests.explanation: Anticipated means eagerly expected or awaited. 'Almost two years' shows just how long fans had been looking forward to it.
quests.textToSpeak: The film's release was anticipated for almost two years.
quests.question: The film's release was _____ for almost two years.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a book's text before it has been printed?
quests.explanation: A manuscript is an author's completed text before publication. 'Before finding a publisher' shows this stage happens well before shops.
quests.textToSpeak: She spent five years writing the manuscript before finding a publisher.
quests.question: She spent five years writing the _____ before finding a publisher.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes putting something at serious risk?
quests.explanation: Jeopardized means put something valuable at serious risk. 'One careless mistake' shows how little it can take to threaten an agreement.
quests.textToSpeak: One careless mistake nearly jeopardized the entire deal.
quests.question: One careless mistake nearly _____ the entire deal.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes meeting the requirements needed for something?
quests.explanation: Eligible describes meeting the specific conditions needed for something. 'Two years' service' is the precise requirement mentioned here.
quests.textToSpeak: Only employees with two years' service are eligible for the bonus.
quests.question: Only employees with two years' service are _____ for the bonus.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a formal statement given as evidence in court?
quests.explanation: Testimony is evidence given, often spoken, particularly in legal settings. 'Crucial to the final verdict' shows how important it was.
quests.textToSpeak: Her testimony in court proved crucial to the final verdict.
quests.question: Her _____ in court proved crucial to the final verdict.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes someone respected because of career achievements?
quests.explanation: Distinguished describes someone whose career achievements have earned wide respect. This word appears when formally introducing respected speakers.
quests.textToSpeak: A distinguished professor gave the opening lecture at the conference.
quests.question: A _____ professor gave the opening lecture at the conference.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a serious attempt to achieve something difficult?
quests.explanation: Endeavor describes a determined attempt at something challenging, often admirable. 'Biggest... of his life' shows how significant this attempt was.
quests.textToSpeak: Starting a business from nothing was the biggest endeavor of his life.
quests.question: Starting a business from nothing was the biggest _____ of his life.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes communicating and cooperating closely with another team?
quests.explanation: Liaised means worked closely with another team through regular communication. This word is common in professional workplace English.
quests.textToSpeak: She liaised closely with the design team throughout the project.
quests.question: She _____ closely with the design team throughout the project.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes automatically losing something for breaking a rule?
quests.explanation: Forfeited means automatically lost something due to a rule violation. Arriving late enough to lose a match by default is a strict consequence.
quests.textToSpeak: The team forfeited the match after arriving twenty minutes late.
quests.question: The team _____ the match after arriving twenty minutes late.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes an amount that is uncomfortably small?
quests.explanation: Meager describes an amount that is uncomfortably small. 'First year abroad' suggests they were still adjusting to new financial pressures.
quests.textToSpeak: They survived on a meager budget during their first year abroad.
quests.question: They survived on a _____ budget during their first year abroad.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes documents that prove your identity or qualifications?
quests.explanation: Credentials are official proof of identity or qualification. 'Restricted area' explains why this level of verification was necessary.
quests.textToSpeak: He was asked to show his credentials before entering the restricted area.
quests.question: He was asked to show his _____ before entering the restricted area.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes officially canceling a right or license?
quests.explanation: Revoked means officially canceled or taken away, often as a penalty. 'Third offense' shows this was a consequence of repeated rule-breaking.
quests.textToSpeak: His driving license was revoked after the third offense.
quests.question: His driving license was _____ after the third offense.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes publicly supporting a cause or policy?
quests.explanation: Advocated means publicly argued in support of something. 'After the incident' shows the specific event that prompted this stance.
quests.textToSpeak: The senator advocated for stricter safety laws after the incident.
quests.question: The senator _____ for stricter safety laws after the incident.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes being fair and not favoring either side?
quests.explanation: Impartial describes complete fairness, without favoring either side. This is one of the most essential qualities expected of a judge.
quests.textToSpeak: A judge must remain completely impartial throughout the trial.
quests.question: A judge must remain completely _____ throughout the trial.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes everyone agreeing, with no one disagreeing?
quests.explanation: Unanimously describes total agreement, without a single dissenting vote. This shows unusually strong, shared support for the decision.
quests.textToSpeak: The board voted unanimously to approve the merger.
quests.question: The board voted _____ to approve the merger.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes people affected by or invested in a decision?
quests.explanation: Stakeholders are people or organizations affected by or invested in a decision. Involving them 'before the vote' shows a fair, transparent process.
quests.textToSpeak: The proposal was presented to all major stakeholders before the vote.
quests.question: The proposal was presented to all major _____ before the vote.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes the unpleasant effects felt after an action?
quests.explanation: Repercussions are consequences that appear after the fact, often unwanted. 'Long-term' emphasizes that these effects weren't immediately obvious.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody had considered the long-term repercussions of the decision.
quests.question: Nobody had considered the long-term _____ of the decision.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes never stopping despite difficulty?
quests.explanation: Relentless describes unstoppable persistence despite obstacles. 'Years of setbacks' shows exactly what this determination had to overcome.
quests.textToSpeak: Her relentless determination eventually paid off after years of setbacks.
quests.question: Her _____ determination eventually paid off after years of setbacks.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes strongly and publicly criticizing something?
quests.explanation: Denounced means publicly and strongly condemned something. This word is common in formal statements from governments and officials.
quests.textToSpeak: World leaders denounced the attack as a violation of international law.
quests.question: World leaders _____ the attack as a violation of international law.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a past decision used as a guide for later situations?
quests.explanation: Precedent is a past decision that guides future ones in similar situations. This word is central to how legal systems build consistency.
quests.textToSpeak: The ruling set an important legal precedent for future cases.
quests.question: The ruling set an important legal _____ for future cases.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.
